tasks.label: CMake: Configure (Pico 2)
tasks.detail: 🛠️ Configures Pico 2 project inside the subfolder.

tasks.label: CMake: Build & Show %
tasks.command: cmake --build ./pico_sdk_sigrok/build ; $elf='./pico_sdk_sigrok/build/pico_sdk_sigrok.elf' ; if (Test-Path $elf) { $stats = arm-none-eabi-size $elf | Select-String -Pattern '\d+' ; $vals = [regex]::Matches($stats, '\d+') | % { [int]$_.Value } ; $f_pct = [math]::Round(($vals[0] / 16MB) * 100, 2) ; $r_pct = [math]::Round(($vals[1] / 520KB) * 100, 2) ; Write-Host '--- 📊 Usage Summary ---' -ForegroundColor Cyan ; Write-Host ('💾 Flash: {0} bytes ({1}%) of 16MB' -f $vals[0], $f_pct) ; Write-Host ('🧠 SRAM:  {0} bytes ({1}%) of 520KB' -f $vals[1], $r_pct) }
tasks.detail: 📊 Build the code and show statistics

tasks.label: Build and Upload
tasks.command: Write-Host '🚀 Starting Build...' -ForegroundColor Cyan ; cmake --build ./pico_sdk_sigrok/build ; $COM_PORT='COM15' ; $DRIVE_LETTER='E:' ; Write-Host "🔄 Resetting Pico on $COM_PORT..." -ForegroundColor Yellow ; mode $COM_PORT baud=1200 > $null ; Start-Sleep -s 3 ; if (Test-Path $DRIVE_LETTER) { Write-Host "📤 Uploading to $DRIVE_LETTER..." -ForegroundColor Green ; copy ./pico_sdk_sigrok/build/*.uf2 $DRIVE_LETTER ; Write-Host '✅ Success!' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '❌ Pico drive not found. Is it in BOOT mode?' -ForegroundColor Red }
tasks.detail: 🚀 Forces pico into boot and upload the code
